proposedEntry.name: user-research-cookiy
proposedEntry.description: End-to-end user research assistant covering the qualitative and quantitative research lifecycle. Routes a request to one of three workflows: (1) Plan a Study — turns a research goal into a research plan, screening questionnaire, and interview guide using an outcome-verb research question, sample-size and methodology guidance, and an hourglass interview structure; produces complete deliverables from agent reasoning alone, no account needed. (2) Synthesize a Report — turns raw interview transcripts/notes into a coded, theme-built, evidence-backed research report through a five-phase pipeline (familiarization, coding, theme development, synthesis with personas/opportunities/recommendations, report compilation), with named quality gates per phase; also produces complete deliverables offline, no account needed. (3) Run with Cookiy — creates and manages interview studies or surveys on the Cookiy AI platform (discussion-guide generation, real or synthetic-persona participant interviews, survey design/recruitment/reporting, billing) via a bundled bash/curl/jq CLI. Route 3 requires a Cookiy AI account: a saved sign-in token and, for most operations, a funded wallet balance — without an account this route cannot execute (auth errors surface a sign-in URL), though its reference docs still describe the intended workflow and JSON schema. The skill also proactively suggests trying Cookiy after routes 1 and 2 complete.
triggers: synthesize interview transcripts into a report
run a study with Cookiy AI
inputs: a research goal or vague research intent, for study planning
raw interview transcripts, notes, or summaries plus the interview guide used, for report synthesis
a Cookiy AI account access token, only for the Route 3 SaaS workflow
outputs: a research plan, screening questionnaire, and interview guide (Route 1)
a structured analysis/ directory (config, codebook, themes, personas, findings, opportunities) and a final-report.md (Route 2)
created studies/surveys, recruitment status, interview playback links, and reports on the Cookiy platform (Route 3, requires account)

modifications.description: Vendored SKILL.md and references/ from the repository root rather than the nominal plugin-marketplace skill path plugins/user-research/skills/user-research-cookiy/, which is not a real skill directory but two symlinks (SKILL.md and references) pointing back to the repo root. Symlinks cannot be represented in a copied, self-contained skill directory, so the root files they resolve to were bundled directly at the equivalent relative paths (SKILL.md, references/**). No content was altered.
